prioritized_actions.title: Optimize Title Tag Length & CTR Hook
prioritized_actions.rationale: Titles over 60 chars are truncated in SERPs with ellipses. Target 50-60 chars with primary keyword front-loaded.

prioritized_actions.title: Rewrite Meta Description with Active Call-to-Action
prioritized_actions.rationale: Descriptions over 160 chars are clipped. Overly short descriptions fail to compel searcher clicks.

prioritized_actions.title: Consolidate Multiple H1 Headings into Single Logical H1
prioritized_actions.rationale: Multiple H1 tags dilute topical focus. Best practice is a single clear H1 reflecting page intent.

prioritized_actions.title: Harden Technical Trust & Security Headers
prioritized_actions.rationale: HSTS and Content-Security-Policy prevent security downgrades and satisfy AI agent reliability gates.

prioritized_actions.title: Add Organization Schema & Entity Anchors
prioritized_actions.finding: No Organization / LocalBusiness entity defined in structured data.
prioritized_actions.rationale: Essential for establishing E-E-A-T and anchoring your entity in Google's Knowledge Graph.

prioritized_actions.title: Publish Standard /llms.txt AI Agent Manifest
prioritized_actions.rationale: Provides AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) with clean, curated markdown documentation.
